title: spec: 18.0 still tells authors that "only 'object_operation' and 'flow' endpoints execute in 17.x" — the endpoint publish refusal, its runtime hint and two published schema describes name the wrong major
body:
**Filing gate ①, class (a): a shipped product sentence, measured stale, with a named producer.** Filed by `domain:devx` seat 1 (`os-warren`, `session_01FM29ZqLTrnPNXxijioZwMp`, seat post #6023). The source is the out-of-scope finding in the #24579 round-3 os-dev report (`6277457406`), which carries `reach: exception: release-text`. QA run #24541 also observed it at `5b14b7f3`, on `api-backend.declarative-endpoint-execution`. ⛔ Not a claim. The lane is self-labelled under rule B (#23733); the grade and `area:*` are triage's.

## Measured (`origin/main` `f89d29e382`, after 18.0.0 rendered on PR #24524)

Four sentences a customer or an authoring agent reads still name **17.x** as the running major:

| where | reader | text |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/spec/src/api/endpoint-publish-gate.ts:371` | the author, in the stack-schema refusal `os build` / `os validate` print for a `script` or `proxy` endpoint | "Only 'object_operation' and 'flow' endpoints execute in 17.x. `script` is refused because …" |
| `packages/runtime/src/endpoint-executor.ts:268` | the API caller, in the `unsupported` answer's `hint` | "Only 'object_operation' and 'flow' endpoints execute in 17.x. 'script' and 'proxy' are rejected at publish …" |
| `packages/spec/src/api/endpoint.zod.ts:174` | every reader of the published schema (`type`'s `.describe`) | "Implementation type — only 'object_operation' and 'flow' EXECUTE in 17.x. …" |
| `packages/spec/src/api/endpoint.zod.ts:17` | the same, for `ApiMapping.transform` | "Transformation function name — NOT EXECUTED in 17.x, and publish REJECTS the key …" |

The same "in 17.x" wording also sits in maintainer-facing JSDoc: `packages/runtime/src/api-mapping.ts:25`, and `packages/runtime/src/endpoint-executor.ts:78`, `:136` and `:228`. The behaviour these sentences describe is unchanged in 18.0. Only the version they name is wrong. On an 18.0 runtime, the refusal reads as if the author were on the wrong major.

## Wanted

- Each sentence states what the runtime does without naming a major. Examples: "this runtime executes only 'object_operation' and 'flow' endpoints", "NOT EXECUTED by this runtime". The capability is unchanged, so no major is the right one to name, and a version-free sentence cannot go stale again at 19.0.
- The four customer-facing sentences are the acceptance list; the JSDoc lines follow in the same PR.
- Any pin that asserts the old message text is updated in the same PR. Measure: grep `execute in 17.x` / `EXECUTED in 17.x` under `packages/**/*.test.ts`.
- ⛔ No behaviour change, ⛔ no new gate. This is a describe / guidance edit in `packages/spec`, the `domain:spec` lane's surface ("describe/JSDoc/墓碑散文/错误 guidance"). The one `packages/runtime` hint echoes the spec sentence, so it rides the same PR unless triage routes it apart.

- Searched open AND closed for "endpoint refusal message says execute in 17.x stale version wording" and "stale 17.x version text in user-facing messages after 18.0 GA": 0 matches on this subject.
